summary: Every SEC Office of the Whistleblower annual report (FY2011-FY2025) and every CFTC whistleblower annual report (FY2011-FY2025) was read; CFTC reports are stored, SEC reports could only be read from Wayback copies because sec.gov blocks downloads. Yearly tips, allegation and country splits (SEC to FY2023), awards awarded vs. cash paid, fund balances, denials where printed, the statutory and regulatory award rules, and about 150 award cases from the reports and the CFTC orders list are included. Note that 'awarded' (announced) and 'paid from the Fund' differ every year and are kept as separate rows.

programs.name: SEC Whistleblower Program (Office of the Whistleblower)
programs.notes: Created by Dodd-Frank Act s.922 (Exchange Act s.21F, 15 U.S.C. 78u-6), signed 21 July 2010; Regulation 21F effective 12 Aug 2011. Pays 10-30% of monetary sanctions collected in SEC actions over $1 million (and related actions) to people who voluntarily give original information. Awards come from the Investor Protection Fund, financed by SEC sanctions. Tips can be anonymous through a lawyer. Rules amended 2020 (presumption of maximum award up to $5m, DPAs/NPAs count) and 2022.

programs.name: CFTC Whistleblower Program (Whistleblower Office)
programs.notes: Created by Dodd-Frank Act s.748 (CEA s.23, 7 U.S.C. 26), signed 21 July 2010; Part 165 rules effective 24 Oct 2011, amended 2017 and 2024. Pays 10-30% of sanctions collected in CFTC actions over $1 million (and related actions). Awards and the customer education office are paid from the Customer Protection Fund, refilled from sanctions only when its balance is $100 million or less. First award paid FY2014.
